Tap the floating bubble to unlock or switch apps. You can also end the lock from the notification.
Root only: forces the navigation overlay and immersive fullscreen. Hardware keys are untouched.

1. Choose the game you want to lock.
2. Tap “Grant Root access” and approve the Root prompt.
3. Tap “Start lock”. Locky forces the three-button navigation overlay and immersive fullscreen.

Locky does not rely on the ordinary navigation_mode setting. It switches the Android SystemUI navigation overlay directly, which also works on systems that ignore navigation_mode.

The game keeps its own fullscreen window and receives touch input natively. Nothing is embedded or re-injected.

To exit, tap the floating bubble and choose “Unlock”, or end the lock from the notification. “Switch app” opens the app picker while keeping the lock active.

The power button is not intercepted. Hardware keys remain untouched.
